parameters.query: SELECT id, title, description, status, due_date::text AS due_date, priority, notion_page_id, created_from FROM crm_dev.tasks WHERE notion_page_id IS NULL OR updated_at > coalesce(last_synced_at, 'epoch') ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT 50;
UPDATE crm_dev.tasks SET notion_page_id = $1, last_synced_at = now() WHERE id = $2;
